text_block_list.text: I brought Ikuno Dictus to the infirmary to get her condition back in order...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply sorry.
I neglected my own condition...
I will take a short rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Give it your all, everyone!
Just one more point and we win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa, whew... No moore, I can't~~!
I'm so beat~~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little further. We've got our coordination down,
so let's keep this momentum through to the final goal—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Kh, wait a minute!
Is that... smoke coming from the other team's goal...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The goal... flew up into the sky?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~~~~!?
Y-You went that far just to stop them from reaching the goal!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No way, to fail to seize victory
with a hand like this...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...The goal was launched into the sky...
Now it's impossible to score a goal.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let us launch one too.
The ball, soaring high into the sky!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right!
If we join forces, I know we can do it!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Huh? Y-You think so?
I kind of feel like... maybe you're right...??

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
All right, here we go!
Let's put all our power into this ball!!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Gooooooo for it!!
(*Shing!* *Fwoosh!*)

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOOAL!!
Right at the edge of the atmosphere!
The match has been decided right nowww!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We did it…… Everyone, we did it!
Victory is ours!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Turning the impossible into possible through sheer impossibility...
Now then, let's go toss the manager into the air!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Cheers with carrot juice!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I feel as though
I just had a very refreshing dream...

Ikuno Dictus has gotten back into shape.
For some reason, she was smiling slightly...
Either way, she seemed to have recovered!
